bio: With mosaic tile flooring, warm wood tones and vintage knickknacks, the interior feels relaxing and modern; meanwhile, the patio beneath a canopy is perfect for al fresco dining. The chef champions borderless cuisine, melding eclectic influences from around the world – Indian, Chinese, European, LatAm and even Fijian touches feature in his ingenious creations that work like a charm. Try the tandoori bread with butter spread perfumed by citrus and pepper aromas....
